result:
SL-006 is implemented and committed as `bc04e87`. `npm test` passes (22 tests, 0 failing) and `npm run typecheck` is clean.

I wrote `tests/delete.test.ts` first and ran it against the old code. Five tests failed. The "non-numeric id answers 404" test already passed, because an unknown route returns 404 on its own.

- **AC-1 (delete):** `DELETE /api/tasks/:id` answers 204 and removes only that row. A test kills the server with `kill -9`, restarts it on the same database file and checks the task has not come back. The page now has a "Delete" button on each task that calls `confirm()` before sending the request, then reloads the list. The page-side test only checks the script text: that `confirm(` comes before `DELETE`, and that there is no `innerHTML`. Nothing runs the confirm dialog in a browser, so the click behaviour is untested.
- **AC-2 (missing task):** deleting an id that doesn't exist answers 404 with `{ "error": { "code": "not_found", "message": "Task not found" } }`. This also covers deleting the same task twice, and a non-numeric id.

The changes are in `src/tasks.ts` (`deleteTask`), `src/app.ts` (the route) and `public/app.js`. I did not update `.sddpp/slices/SL-006-delete-a-task.md`, which still says `status: planned`, or `.sddpp/wbs.md`.
